title: VDP Audit Log Record
description: One line of the append-only, hash-chained JSONL audit log. SPEC.md section 6.1. On disk, records MUST be serialized with ensure_ascii=true — see SPEC.md section 6.1 for why.

seq.description: Contiguous from 0. Ordering comes from this and the hash chain, never from a timestamp — no record contains one.

action.description: The raw ConcreteAction as submitted, before abstraction. Values that are not JSON scalars are stored as their repr() so an unserializable payload cannot corrupt the log.

symbol.description: The abstracted Sigma symbol alpha(action) actually decided on.

pre_state.description: Counter valuations before this action, in Policy.counters order. ["q_bad"] if the automaton was already absorbed (does not occur in practice: a BLOCK never advances state).

post_state.description: Counter valuations after. Equal to pre_state when decision is BLOCK.

reason.description: Human-readable reason for the decision. Empty string permitted on ALLOW.

token_id.description: Stable identifier for the token's scope chain (SPEC.md section 5.5), or the literal sentinel "<no-token>" when no token was presented. Exempt from the 64-hex-character requirement below.

hex64.description: SHA-256 or HMAC-SHA256 output, hex. Validated as exactly 64 lowercase hex characters on parse, not just type-checked — SPEC.md section 6.1 explains why (a non-hex value reaching hmac.compare_digest can raise instead of returning false).
